Name: Build Placement Unlocker
Author: PureWinter
Description:
[b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Toggle on/off build anywhere with left control. Middle Mouse = Undo[/size][/color]
[i]Includes a pleasant sound effect, visual green dot in upper left, both can be disabled using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu[/url].
All menu options are fully localized to every language the game supports.[/i][/b]

1.2 Update:
-Added middle mouse button = Undo! Placed something and it went behind something else? Don't want to click to pick it up AGAIN? Slap middle mouse (configurable to a different button) and it's back in your hand ready to place! Huge time saver.

This mod works on vanilla and modded placeables. All placeable objects can now be placed:
-Inside Pelican town/Custom area shops and homes.
-Outside in the town.
-Interior only items can now be placed outside, on your farm or elsewhere.
-Extends range of placement. Use right click to pick up the item. (Prevents accidental moving with left click.)
-Generic Mod Config Menu support for range/behaviors.
-Allows layering/overlap of items which is useful for mod items or sticking things on/right behind trees.

Additionally this mod:
-Allows NPCs to pass through your placed decor unhindered.
-Hides decor during festivals, and returns them after. [Tell me if one doesn't do this.]
-Doesn't interfere with function of items, such as the catalogue, seating, etc. 

Usage note:
While you can still place 'forbidden' items like windows at a distance, the preview footprint is red. Just left click to place anyway, and right click to remove. :)
